observations: Professional LED headlight with a circular lens and four external barn doors.
The light is mounted on a black tripod stand.
The image contains a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI THE CONTENT ZONE'.
The seller's text mentions 'LED Red Head Light' and 'photography, videography', but the photo shows a white light output.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a white light, not red.

risks.risk: The light may not power on or produce a red color.
risks.proof: A video showing the light switched on and emitting red light.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or the battery compartment may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and a video of the light running on battery power.

risks.risk: The internal LED may be damaged or the lens may be scratched.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens and the back of the unit.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the light powered on and showing the red color.
Close-up photos of the lens and the back of the unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
